description: Replaces Dependabot's version updates, with the same rules .github/dependabot.yml had (that file now only shapes Dependabot's security PRs).

Security fixes stay with Dependabot (alerts and security updates on as GitHub settings; dependabot-auto-merge.yml merges its PRs): it updates vulnerable packages that only appear in package-lock.json or Cargo.lock, which Renovate's own security PRs do not.
Every commit type here is chore or ci, never fix or feat, so a dependency update never triggers a release-please release (config:recommended alone would write fix(deps) for production dependencies).

packageRules.description: npm: commits as chore(deps), package.json ranges raised as Dependabot did; minor and patch updates in one PR.
Cargo (src-tauri/): commits as chore(deps). In-range updates change only Cargo.lock and a major raises Cargo.toml's requirement, as Dependabot did; minor and patch updates in one PR.
GitHub Actions: commits as ci(deps); minor and patch updates in one PR. SHA-pinned actions stay pinned.

Node is pinned in .nvmrc and as node-version in ci.yml (twice) and release.yml, which must move together (AGENTS.md). One PR moves them; the major-only range ('26') is kept, and a new major waits for a person.
